name: Summoned
source:
You are a demon who has been trapped in a summoning circle. You must probe, trick and scheme to escape and ultimately punish your captors.

[From [url=https://greenclovers.itch.io/summoned]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个被困在召唤圈中的恶魔。你必须通过调查、欺骗和策划来逃脱并最终惩罚绑架者。

[来自[url=https://greenclovers.itch.io/summoned]itch.io[/url]]
